name: google_container_cluster
description: Manages a Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) cluster

location.name: location
location.description: The location (region or zone) in which the cluster master will be created

project.name: project
project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs

network.name: network
network.description: The name or self_link of the Google Compute Engine network

subnetwork.name: subnetwork
subnetwork.description: The name or self_link of the Google Compute Engine subnetwork

initial_node_count.name: initial_node_count
initial_node_count.description: The number of nodes to create in this cluster default node pool

remove_default_node_pool.name: remove_default_node_pool
remove_default_node_pool.description: If true, deletes the default node pool upon cluster creation

min_master_version.name: min_master_version
min_master_version.description: The minimum version of the master

deletion_protection.name: deletion_protection
deletion_protection.description: Whether or not to allow Terraform to destroy the cluster
